detail_text: Specifically, A. The gowns worn by operators when working in the ISO 5 hood are not sterile and the surgical masks do not provide adequate coverage to the forehead, neck or face. Your procedure SOP 7.011 "Gowning and Gloving" allows for re-use of the gown during the production day to re-enter the ISO 5 and ISO 7 areas. On 08/04-05/14 we observed the operator store the mask and hairnet used while producing sterile drugs in the sleeve of her gown and re-used these items throughout the day. Additionally, an operator was observed wearing her personal tinted eyeglasses during filling of Avastin lot 20140805@1, which were not disinfected. B. On 08/05/14 during the repackaging of Avastin Lot 20140805@1 in the ISO 5 hood the operator's wrists were exposed due to inadequate glove and gown cover.

detail_text: Specifically, Exception E-0585021 was initiated on 5/21/09 when a staff member was observed performing an arm preparation inappropriately. The employee's last quarterly arm scrub assessment was conducted on 3/8/09. A total of359 whole blood numbers were involved. The Donor and Client Support Center (DCSC) was notified on 5/22/09 to gain contro l of the product s. (DCSC is responsible for performing component notifications and retrieval.) A Corporate Material Revi ew Board (cMRB) Investigation, cMRB Log Number: 09-104, was held 6/3/09 and determined all in-date distribut ed components should be recalle d. Component Status Change Record (P200905221516o34-CSCR) was initiated by DCSC to document the notification and retrieval of the components manufactured from the uni ts. The initial gain control activit ies were performed within the required 48 hour timeframe, however, consign ees were not notified of the recall for three in- date AS-1 red blood cells (RBC's) manufactured from units 022FN10611-expiration date 5/21/09, 022FN10613-expiration date 5/21/09, and 022FN10616-expiration date 5/21 /09. NRM (not Retrieved per MRB decision; components not affected) was documented on the CSCR for the final disposition of the three AS-1RB C's. On 4/5/10, the Center for Biologics Evalua tion and Research (CBER) contacted Penn-Jersey Region Quality Assurance (QA) and requested recall information for this prob lem. Subsequent to the CBER notification, Penn-Jersey QA reviewed the recall file and noted that the consignees for the three AS-I RBC's had not been notified of the re call. On 4/29/10, Penn-Jersey QA notified DCSC of the need to send recall notifications to the consi gnees. Written notification of the recall was not sent to consignees until 5 /28/10. A pro blem (E­0813697) was not logged into the Automated Problem Management System regarding the failure to follow up on the recall until 6/2/10.
detail_text_ko: 구체적으로, Exception E-0585021 은 5/21/09 에 한 직원이 팔 소독(arm preparation)을 부적절하게 수행하는 것이 관찰되었을 때 개시되었다. 해당 직원의 마지막 분기별 팔 소독 평가는 3/8/09 에 수행되었다. 전혈 번호 총 359개가 관련되었다. 제품을 통제하기 위해 5/22/09 에 Donor and Client Support Center(DCSC)에 통보되었다. (DCSC 는 혈액 성분 통보와 회수를 담당한다.) Corporate Material Review Board(cMRB) 조사(cMRB Log Number: 09-104)가 6/3/09 에 열렸고 유효 기간 내 유통된 모든 성분을 회수해야 한다고 결정했다. 해당 혈액 단위에서 제조된 성분의 통보와 회수를 기록하기 위해 DCSC 가 Component Status Change Record(P200905221516o34-CSCR)를 개시했다. 초기 통제 활동은 요구되는 48시간 이내에 수행되었으나, 단위 022FN10611-유효 기간 5/21/09, 022FN10613-유효 기간 5/21/09, 022FN10616-유효 기간 5/21 /09 에서 제조된 유효 기간 내 AS-1 적혈구(RBC) 세 건에 대해서는 수령처(consignee)에 회수가 통보되지 않았다. 세 AS-1RB C 의 최종 처분에 대해 CSCR 에는 NRM(MRB 결정에 따라 회수하지 않음; 성분은 영향 없음)이 기록되었다. 4/5/10 에 Center for Biologics Evaluation and Research(CBER)가 Penn-Jersey Region Quality Assurance(QA)에 연락하여 이 문제에 대한 회수 정보를 요청했다. CBER 통보 이후 Penn-Jersey QA 가 회수 파일을 검토하여 세 AS-I RBC 의 수령처에 회수가 통보되지 않았음을 확인했다. 4/29/10 에 Penn-Jersey QA 는 DCSC 에 수령처에 회수 통보를 보낼 필요가 있다고 통보했다. 회수에 대한 서면 통보는 5 /28/10 까지 수령처에 발송되지 않았다. 회수 후속 조치 실패에 대한 문제(E­0813697)는 6/2/10 까지 자동 문제 관리 시스템(Automated Problem Management System)에 기록되지 않았다.
